applicability.expression: encounter.kind == 'registration' AND SchizophreniaEstablished == 'Yes' AND SubstantialSuicideRisk == 'Yes' AND SuicideRiskPersistsDespiteOtherTreatments == 'Yes'
applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind and gate node states only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: assessed No on any gate member yields not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior; a false gate is never a negative posterior). Missing, partial, skipped-not_assessed, or conflicting gate member yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected input creates a new run. Missing required non-gate input (urgent concern, clozapine status) yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (adherence, modifiable targets, willingness, monitoring plan, medical review) leaves that node without hard evidence; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All mapped states are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unanswered, partial, skipped not_assessed, bypassed, or conflicting diagnosis blocks with needs_clarification (gate member). A bypassed diagnosis is not a confirmation.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician confirmation recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff diagnosis is complete with criteria met AND clinician confirmation is recorded in the current encounter; No iff assessed and not confirmed. Never inferred from symptom counts alone.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing, partial, skipped not_assessed, or conflicting judgment blocks with needs_clarification (gate member).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; supporting C-SSRS inputs carry their own current-vs-historical designations (proposed windows: past-month ideation, past-3-month behavior, pending owner)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the clinician records a substantial current risk for suicide attempts or suicide with assessment date, ideation/attempt summary, instrument name/version, and rationale. C-SSRS severity 0-5, intensity, behavior, and lethality inform the judgment but no level maps to Yes by itself; an unassessed C-SSRS can never yield Yes. No iff the clinician assesses the criterion as not met; a negative C-SSRS screen alone is not No.

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (catalog references or explicit unknown labels; status only, no regimen detail)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing, partial, or conflicting determination blocks with needs_clarification (gate member).
patient_mappings.time_window: determination in current_encounter; supporting treatment history in historical_interval with recorded treatments, dates, response, and adherence evidence
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the clinician documents that substantial suicide-related risk persists despite other treatments, with the reviewed treatments, dates, response, and adherence evidence. Explicitly not defined as two failed antipsychotic trials and not equivalent to treatment resistance; no count threshold is applied.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing urgent assessment blocks with needs_clarification (required non-gate input).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; C-SSRS currency per the proposed past-month/past-3-month windows pending owner
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Present iff the C-SSRS high-risk alert fires (current ideation level 4/5 or recent suicidal behavior) OR the clinician records an acute suicide-related concern or serious suspected treatment harm requiring urgent assessment. Absent iff the clinician assesses no urgent concern AND no high-risk alert fires in the current window. Absent does not certify safety.

patient_mappings.missing_policy: unknown or not_assessed leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.time_window: historical_interval (registration); recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff a documented adherence problem or uncertainty about actual exposure needs clinical review; No iff adherence is assessed adequate in the reviewed window. Distinct from entirely missing adherence assessment.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing (the conditioning context notes the gap, with owner review of this rationale)

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.suicide_risk.modifiable_targets (PROPOSED structured field, not collected; Statement 3 plan targets)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the clinician identifies potentially modifiable suicide-risk factors requiring treatment-plan attention; No iff assessed none. Never derived from a checklist, demographics, or a scale total.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.medications (catalog clozapine ingredient reference or explicit unknown label; status only)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing or conflicting exposure status blocks with needs_clarification (required non-gate input; owner to confirm whether to relax to optional, Q7).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for current treatment; historical_event_dates for prior exposure
patient_mappings.typed_transform: CurrentTreatment takes precedence if presently receiving clozapine; PreviouslyTreated iff past exposure is recorded; NeverTreated iff assessed never treated. Status only: no dose, duration, unit, route, or frequency is used or requested (FR-14).

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff the patient is currently willing to discuss clozapine; No iff currently unwilling. Willingness is not consent to treatment, and No never removes the indication flag.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; feasibility per current local guidance
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff a feasible clinician-reviewed monitoring and follow-up plan is available, including ANC and relevant cardiac, bowel, metabolic, and other adverse-effect surveillance per current local guidance. No means a documented planning or logistical gap, not an absolute contraindication.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

allowed_source_paths: runs.pinned_ddi_report (separate informational report; never substituted for this review)
patient_mappings.missing_policy: missing leaves no hard evidence on this node; inference proceeds with unknown disclosure (optional input).
patient_mappings.typed_transform: Yes iff a current clinician or pharmacist benefit-harm, contraindication, and interaction review is documented. Yes means the review was performed, not that clozapine is safe or appropriate; the conclusion remains a clinician responsibility. DDI findings stay a separate report and never substitute for this review.
patient_mappings.usage: both when assessed; estimation-context-only when missing

reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branches rendered as review prompts only; the maximum posterior is never a treatment recommendation. Indication, plan-review, and preparation posteriors are always shown alongside the pathway branch as parallel review concerns. The deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs is shown first and never waits for the LLM. A false gate yields not_applicable (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior); an unknown required gate yields needs_clarification and stops later questions.
title: High-suicide clozapine review at registration (R4)
